title: Footer colophon

intent.caption: Footer colophon — A footer colophon with type-scale discipline: wordmark, three link columns, legal line, hairline rules.

textContent.text: (c) 2026 Nova Atelier. All rights reserved. Machined in Geneva.

visualSpec.effects: Footer band 6.8w x 2.0h scene units, albedo vertical ramp #121218 (at 0.0) -> #0b0b10 (at 1.0), roughness 0.6, metalness 0.2, top edge carrying a full-width 0.006-unit hairline rule #23232b; layout on a 0.25-unit baseline grid: wordmark block occupies the left 2.0 units with the wordmark and a 0.3w x 0.02h accent bar #ff2a38 emissive 1.4 beneath it; three link columns each 1.2w with 0.375-unit gutters (1.5x base) to the right, each column led by a header then three links at 1.8 line height; legal line spans the full width 0.375 above the bottom edge, separated by a second 0.006-unit hairline #23232b with 0.25 clearance above and below; link hover color #e8ecf2 -> #ff2a38 over 140ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) with translateZ 0 -> 0.02; mount is a single fade-up of the whole band opacity 0 -> 1 and y +0.2 -> 0 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), no per-item stagger, the colophon arrives as one set object; the key light grazes from upper left so the hairline rules pick up a faint specular edge, reading etched rather than drawn.

sceneSpec.motionNote: The whole colophon fades up once as a single object; hovered links shift to accent red and lift 0.02 units.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 links and legal on band ramp; 3:1 wordmark minimum

contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 links #e8ecf2 on band ramp #121218 (measures above 14:1); legal line 4.5:1 minimum; 3:1 for the 34px wordmark
